title: coder/coder
title_zh: 自助托管云开发环境与AI编码代理平台

paragraphs.en: Secure environments for developers and their agents
paragraphs.zh: 为开发者及其智能体打造的安全环境

paragraphs.en: Coder is a self-hosted platform for cloud development environments and AI coding agents. Workspaces are defined with Terraform, connected through a secure Wireguard® tunnel, and automatically shut down when not used. Coder Agents runs a native AI coding agent whose loop executes in the control plane on your infrastructure, with no API keys in workspaces.
paragraphs.zh: Coder 是一个用于云开发环境和 AI 编码智能体的自托管平台。 工作区通过 Terraform 定义，经由安全的 Wireguard® 隧道连接，并在闲置时自动关闭。 Coder Agents 运行原生 AI 编码智能体，其循环在您的基础设施上的控制平面中执行，工作区中无需任何 API 密钥。

sents.en: Coder is a self-hosted platform for cloud development environments and AI coding agents.
sents.zh: Coder 是一个用于云开发环境和 AI 编码智能体的自托管平台。

sents.en: Workspaces are defined with Terraform, connected through a secure Wireguard® tunnel, and automatically shut down when not used.

sents.en: Coder Agents runs a native AI coding agent whose loop executes in the control plane on your infrastructure, with no API keys in workspaces.
sents.zh: Coder Agents 运行原生 AI 编码智能体，其循环在您的基础设施上的控制平面中执行，工作区中无需任何 API 密钥。

paragraphs.en: Check out our install guides for other methods and a complete tutorial.
paragraphs.zh: 查看我们的安装指南以了解其他方法和完整教程。

paragraphs.en: Try Coder with the install script on Linux and macOS, or grab the latest binary or installer from GitHub Releases on Windows:
paragraphs.zh: 在 Linux 和 macOS 上使用安装脚本试用 Coder，或在 Windows 上从 GitHub Releases 获取最新的二进制文件或安装程序：

paragraphs.en: curl -fsSL https://coder.com/install.sh | sh Start the server and open http://localhost:3000 to create your initial user, create a Docker template, and provision your first workspace:
paragraphs.zh: curl -fsSL https://coder.com/install.sh | sh 启动服务器并打开 http://localhost:3000，创建你的初始用户，创建一个 Docker 模板，并配置你的第一个工作区：

paragraphs.en: coder server For a production deployment, add a PostgreSQL database (version 13 or later) and an external access URL, and see our validated architectures for sizing and infrastructure guidance:
paragraphs.zh: coder server 对于生产环境部署，请添加一个 PostgreSQL 数据库（版本 13 或更高版本）和一个外部访问 URL，并参阅我们的已验证架构以获取容量规划与基础设施指导：

paragraphs.en: coder server --postgres-url < url > --access-url < url > Without these flags, Coder uses a built-in database and sets up a *.try.coder.app access URL for evaluation. Use coder --help for the full list of flags and environment variables.
paragraphs.zh: coder server --postgres-url < url > --access-url < url > 如果不使用这些标志，Coder 会使用内置数据库，并设置一个 *.try.coder.app 访问 URL 供评估使用。 使用 coder --help 查看标志和环境变量的完整列表。

sents.en: coder server --postgres-url < url > --access-url < url > Without these flags, Coder uses a built-in database and sets up a *.try.coder.app access URL for evaluation.

sents.en: Use coder --help for the full list of flags and environment variables.
sents.zh: 使用 coder --help 查看标志和环境变量的完整列表。

paragraphs.en: Browse the documentation or visit a specific section below:

paragraphs.en: Open an issue for bugs and feature requests.
paragraphs.zh: 针对错误和功能需求提交 issue（议题）。

paragraphs.en: For community support, showcasing what you built, and feedback on in-progress features, join our Discord or GitHub Discussions .
paragraphs.zh: 如需社区支持、展示你构建的作品，以及获得对开发中功能的反馈，请加入我们的 Discord 或 GitHub Discussions。

paragraphs.en: Dedicated support is included in Coder Premium. For more information, visit coder.com/pricing .
paragraphs.zh: Coder Premium 包含专属支持服务。 更多信息请访问 coder.com/pricing。
